criteria: E >= 130 x measured cycle at the selected k (design 6.3: k=4 needs 2.90 at CPU 0.118 / 2.72 at 0.090; k=5 needs 3.23 / 2.88). Measured 16K: 2.850 (k=4), 3.055 (k=5), so both pass only at CPU 0.090 (RESULTS section 19)
per-pass submit+sync < 1 ms, and the GPU leg within 10% of the roofline model at k=1/2/4/5/8
locality within 5 pp of M0 on non-technical text (M1-2b: chat 81.6, multi 87.3, code 66.0)
two miss legs measured and the cycle recomputed with an adaptive split (RESULTS section 9)
VRAM budget closes with q4 KV + a 16384-token resident window (21.9% expert cache, RESULTS section 10)
PP feasibility recorded: int8 ALU 8.67 TFLOPS, expert GEMM baseline 3.66 (RESULTS section 14); PP >= 1000 stays a hard floor (user 2026-10-24) and M2-4 must reach 6.0 TFLOPS
code-included TG feasibility: CPU expert <=0.059 ms at 4 threads (target 0.055, ~107 GFLOPS) with H2D 10.8 gives code TG 130; current 0.118 gives 82 (RESULTS section 17)

speculative output fidelity under the U-7 rule: divergence is allowed only where greedy's top-1 margin is below 0.05 nats. k=4 passed 2x128 tokens with no fork (max batch perturbation 0.0808, tightest margins 0.1192/0.1286); k=5 forks at a 0.1192 margin and fails (RESULTS sections 21/23)
CPU expert leg: the user moved M3-1a inside the gate (U-6). Technical text needs <=0.090 ms/expert, code needs <=0.059 (target 0.055); the measured E clears 2.72 / 2.88 at 0.090 (RESULTS section 19)
decision_gate.on_fail: stop and ask the user: lower the TG target, change the ctx cost, or page the KV (design section 9)
conditions: conditional pass (user 2026-10-24, option A): code TG 130 and M3-6 stay contingent on M3-1a reaching 0.059 ms/expert; if it does not, go to U-2 and lower the code target

targets.rule: 130/1000 are hard floors until the user re-sets them; the design target is 0.85 x the roofline at the binding leg, reported every round by R0

doc_budget.note: L0 AGENTS.md is injected every session; L1 <dir>/AGENTS.md is subtree scope; L3 docs/agent is read on demand. state_check.py --lint enforces every cap here plus index coverage.

gpu.desc: dGPU and its VRAM: one process at a time

host-ram.desc: a resident 21.28 GiB model plus its KV/state: about 28 GiB free RAM

machine-quiet.desc: anything that perturbs timing or hogs cores: timed runs, full -j8 build, mem/disk probes, repack

disk-io.desc: more than 1 GiB of reads/writes, or any SSD bandwidth measurement

trace-bin.desc: regenerating a routing trace .bin; reading an existing one is shared

prompt-file.desc: editing a file under bench/prompts/; reading is shared

bench.desc: runs the model or measures the machine; strictly serialized, one agent, one process at a time

impl.desc: writes code and builds it; parallel across agents if paths are disjoint and no bench is running

data.desc: pure text and light CPU: prompts, vocab list, GGUF metadata, analysis, docs; never blocks anyone

io.desc: repack and large-file verification; exclusive with both bench and builds

user.desc: decisions only the user can make; an agent may prepare a one-page choice set, then stop

escalations.question: M2-7a 的 done_when 写 logits 对 CPU 双精度参考 rel_L1 <= 1e-4，但没写 int8 激活打包的口径。两个口径实测都进了 RESULTS#m2-7a-model-ref-chain：共享打包决策 5.93e-07（40 层全覆盖，两臂 KLD 1.79e-13）；两臂各自打包 1.2e-3/层、40 层链 1.387e-01 —— 后者测的是 Q8_1 阶跃导致的轨迹分叉（--norm-check 本来就记着 CPU 与 shader 有 80/655360 个块边界判定不同），不是算术错。请选择模型级判据：(a) rel_L1 只对'打包决策共享'口径判，独立打包口径只报读数；(b) 模型级改用 gates 的 L-MODEL 口径 KLD<=1e-4 + top-1，rel_L1 只留逐层隔离；(c) 保留现写法（那么 M2-7a 在 int8 流水线下结构性不过，需要放宽到 ~2e-1）。建议 (b)。
escalations.needs_by: M2-7 收口前（10.4K 档的 logits 门）
options: (a) rel_L1 只判打包共享口径
(b) 模型级用 KLD<=1e-4+top-1，rel_L1 留逐层（建议）
(c) 保留现写法并放宽阈值
escalations.outcome: 用户 2026-10-26 选 (a)：rel_L1 只对打包决策共享口径判定（实测 5.929e-7），独立打包 4 层链 8.836e-3 / KLD 1.8881e-4 只报读数；不改阈值。M2-7a done_when 已按此口径澄清并收口

escalations.question: M3-2a 的 done_when 要求 k=5、21.9% 缓存下三条腿耗时差 <=10%。实现已把 H2D/CPU 两条 miss 腿平衡到 0.1-0.2%，但 GPU 设备腿 158-190 ms 对 miss 腿 165-249 ms，spread 34.5%（RESULTS#m3-2a-miss-split）。GPU 腿是 pass1+pass2 的 submit->fence 等待，比 design 2.6 的带宽账高约 5 倍，根因是 attention/DeltaNet/router 效率（M2 项），miss 分配改不动它。请选择：(a) M3-2a 保持 partial，先做 GPU 腿的 M2 性能项或跨层 pipeline，再回来判 10%；(b) 以“两条 miss 腿平衡 + 接线正确”收口 M3-2a，把 GPU 腿差距拆成独立性能任务，继续 M3-3/M3-4（建议）；(c) 把 10% 判据改成只对两条 miss 腿判（需要改 done_when）。
options: (a) 保持 partial，先修 GPU 腿再判
(b) 以 miss 腿平衡收口，GPU 腿另立任务（建议）
(c) 改判据为两条 miss 腿
escalations.outcome: 用户选 (b)：M3-2a 以两条 miss 腿平衡（实测 0.1-0.2%）+ 接线正确收口；三条腿 10% 判据转到新任务 M3-2b，由 attention/DeltaNet/router 效率或跨层 overlap 把 GPU 设备腿拉回 ~21 ms/pass 后重跑。
